subject: Post-call: schedule 60-90min ML/Infra deep dive and confirm attendee map
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: schedule 60-90min ML/Infra deep dive and confirm attendee map

Hi Nina — great to meet today. Quick recap: HelioMed is prioritizing low-latency inference for patient-facing summaries and wants a predictable cost profile as usage scales. Per our call, the next step is a technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with your ML/infra leads so we can map architecture, expected QPS, and run through a short runbook demo.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 30, 15:00–16:30 PT
- Wed Dec 1, 09:00–10:30 PT

Please let me know which window works for the core infra team. Also can you confirm the internal roster below (we can add or remove):
- Nina Patel (Platform lead)
- Samir Rao (ML infra)
- Priya Verma (SRE)

If you want, we can keep it to 60 minutes (focused architecture + Q&A) or extend to 90 minutes to include a short runbook demo and performance tuning checklist. I attached a draft agenda and a short questionnaire your engineers can fill out ahead of time.

Next steps: pick a slot and confirm the HelioMed attendees; I'll lock a calendar invite and pull in Marcus and Naomi from our infra/solutions team.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf), heliomed-ops-questions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Nina Patel <nina@heliomed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Team <platform@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: schedule 60-90min ML/Infra deep dive and confirm attendee map

Thanks, Soojin — good summary. We want the 90-minute slot so we can include our SRE and one ML engineer for the runbook demo. Tue Nov 30 at 15:00 PT works for us. Confirmed HelioMed attendees:
- Nina Patel (Platform lead)
- Samir Rao (ML infra)
- Priya Verma (SRE)
- Lauren Kim (Product owner) — optional

I’ll have Samir and Priya fill out the questionnaire you attached and send any specific perf targets (p50/p95 latency, expected concurrency) by EOD Wednesday.

—Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Platform, HelioMed
Nina.Patel@heliomed.com

> Hi Nina — great to meet today. Quick recap: HelioMed is prioritizing low-latency inference...

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: schedule 60-90min ML/Infra deep dive and confirm attendee map

Team — forwarding confirmation from HelioMed. They picked Tue Nov 30, 15:00–16:30 PT (90m). Key asks from the customer:
- Runbook demo (KV/prefix caching and batching examples)
- Expected p50/p95 perf targets from Samir (they'll send by EOD Wed)
- Discussion on quantization profiles and when to recommend 8-bit vs 4-bit for cost/sla trade-offs

Can Marcus own the runbook demo content (15–20m) and Naomi cover deployment/rollout/fallback policy (15–20m)? Ben — can you slot in the cost/quantization recommendations (~10m) and be ready to show an example config?

I've attached the proposed agenda — feel free to update and I’ll share the final invite with HelioMed. Also we should pull a readout of their estimated QPS from the notes in HubSpot so Marcus has context (link below).

Thanks — I’ll create the calendar invite once the agenda is approved.
Soojin

Attachments: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda-v1.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/companies/heliomed

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Nina Patel <nina@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: schedule 60-90min ML/Infra deep dive and confirm attendee map

All set from my side. Quick notes on content and a couple of small changes to the agenda:
- I’ll illustrate a short live-run (prefix-cache warmup + batch sizing) — need console access prepared; Soojin, can you request Samir share a small sample payload (anonymized) ahead of the call?
- Move quantization section earlier so Ben’s recommendations can influence the runbook demo tuning (proposed slot: 30m in).
- I’ve added a 10-minute "fallback and SLA gating" section at the end for production readiness checklist.

Soojin — approved to send the invite. I’ll upload a short deck snippet to the shared Drive after lunch.

Marcus Lin
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
